name: nine-grid-fashion-touching-lens
image_purpose: editorial magazine collage and fashion campaign grid

prompt.project_info: Create a 3x3 editorial fashion contact sheet of an adult model repeatedly reaching toward the camera lens.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, sharp black bob haircut, white oval sunglasses, beige tailored suit over a red sweater vest and white shirt, and a confident contemporary expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Nine aligned panels with front, side, top-down, back, and tilted angles; hand repeatedly reaches toward lens for strong depth and perspective distortion. Minimal neutral-gray studio backdrop, clean high-fashion styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting, crisp focus, bold beige-red-white contrast, contemporary magazine atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 3x3 square contact sheet, 35-50mm editorial lens look, ultra-sharp high-resolution photography, realistic hands and foreshortening, consistent color grade and panel spacing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Editorial fashion 3x3 contact sheet of an adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, sharp black bob haircut, white oval sunglasses, beige tailored suit over a red sweater vest and white shirt, photographed in a minimalist studio with neutral gray backdrop. Nine aligned panels show varied front, side, top-down, back, and tilted angles while the subject repeatedly reaches her hand toward the camera lens, creating strong depth and perspective distortion. Clean high-fashion styling, soft diffused studio lighting, crisp focus, contemporary magazine aesthetic, 35-50mm lens look, ultra-sharp high resolution.
